title: Chart audit follow-up: full inventory, source bridge and Portfolio/OHLCV demos
body:
## Why
The chart audit found missing chart-facing OHLCV contracts and incomplete portfolio visualization coverage. This draft makes those gaps inspectable while preserving the distinction between source availability, a demo, and production completion.

## Changes
Only implementation/experiments/chart-contract-v0.1 changes.
- Searchable inventory: 81 core requirements +24 additional spec requirements +8 Macro candidate requirements. These are not 113 independent charts. Existing canonical/PR40 layer judgments remain distinct; seven newly found requirements are explicitly not fully re-audited.
- Portfolio industry-group donut, independent multi-type exposure rings, and exact-membership overlap bars. Existing 19 target holdings reproduce the user-defined 30/25/20/25 allocation groups. They are reference targets, not actual holdings or GICS classifications.
- Company types and security IDs remain unknown without sourced mapping. Fictional demo demonstrates Growth65% +Quality40% exposure while each ring and disjoint overlap partition retains a total100 denominator.
- Explicit source/version/snapshot metadata, integer input aggregation, unknown vs no-types distinction, cash, blocked-state clearing. Observed-data publication remains blocked.
- Retains shared chart candidate contract, read-only RawDatasetStore bridge, API-first source preflight and synthetic candle/volume renderer. MCP transport remains proposed, not implemented.

## Source evidence
The existing provider/store were reused for one actual no-key NVDA daily5d response and separate split-events response. Exact bytes/hashes and acquisition vs persistence times are retained. Five actual OHLCV rows pass offline source preflight; production identity/session/PIT mapping is incomplete.
Canonical raw scan: 1,404 Yahoo-named latest manifests; 1,346 lack local original files and58 declare TIINGO_DAILY_RAW. This does not invalidate historical owner evidence or replace old vintage with a new sample.

## Verification
-75/75 Node tests:36 contract +17 raw-store +3 captured-source replay +19 portfolio.
- Independent portfolio review:11 checks including40 generated membership cases; source target weights/groups/hashes agree.
- Standalone export:12 OHLCV checks and12 portfolio/inventory checks pass at360/390/1280px. Includes unknown/cash,105% type exposures, exact-set100%, blocked stale-state removal, all113 search/filter entries and no overflow/errors.
- Prior56-test checkpoint is preserved. Failure history includes repaired RSI substring search and previously documented source-metadata/browser-download/locale/font issues.
- Existing Python regression and exact merge-result FPIA are NOT_RUN. No Actions success or canonical readiness is claimed.

## Boundaries
NON_CANONICAL draft based on b8e39a2196a6d7794a04a0cd5393c68329e126ca. No owner branch, existing Python source/tests/workflow, Frozen record, Holdout, numeric policy, grant or canonical merge is changed. No paid service/account credentials.
Demo/reference browser success is not real account, historical PIT, official/live entitlement or end-to-end production completion. Next dependencies: sourced issuer/security/listing identity and session vintage; portfolio classification provenance and actual/quarterly snapshots; owner Web/P01 integration and exact-merge gates.
See CHART_INVENTORY.md, chart_inventory.json, HANDOFF.md, ACCEPTANCE.json, reviews/ and evidence/.

## P0 contract / production wiring design — documentation-only continuation
Audit baseline remains8668c69070c7956cb85d1ccf8cbeb8d9d2daf5cf. Core81 / Extended24 / Research Candidate8 and all earlier runtime/acceptance/inventory files are unchanged.

Added p0-design/P0_CHART_CONTRACT_AND_WIRING_v0.1.md with shared document fields/invariants, exact reuse paths,16 confirmed gap rows, dependency/owner boundaries and16 planned verification cases. Market covers dated identity, OHLCV/session/timezone, source availability/vintage, action/basis and feed state. Portfolio consumes existing Model/Actual domain calculations with independent classification provenance, intentional overlap and lossless numeric encoding. API/Web/future MCP consume one authorized immutable document; no duplicate financial calculations.

46 exact source artifacts are pinned in EVIDENCE.json. Three complementary design reviews completed; explicit portfolio nonfinite/target-validation admission was added, storage-vs-verification wording corrected, and API/MCP same-document hash scope clarified. DESIGN_REVIEW.md preserves initial findings and resolutions.

No runtime/source change, new policy, grant, owner/Frozen modification, broker connection or canonical merge. Earlier75-test evidence remains historical experiment coverage; production verification cases NOT_RUN. Web validator/assembler protected digest and Track C whole-package hash implications are reported before implementation. V/ReverseDCF/MOS/scenario-target production semantics remain deferred to V/QGV reconciliation.


## P0 implementation prerequisite evidence — additive v0.2 proposal
Preserves P0 design v0.1 at 97685dd and audit8668c69 / Core81 / Extended24 / Research Candidate8. Only new p0-prerequisites/ Markdown, evidence JSON and original public responses are added. No production schema, package Python, protected Web validator/assembler, Frozen evidence, grant, Official/LIVE or canonical merge changes.

Market: 19/19 provider-label no-account 5y requests returned HTTP200. Exact bytes/hashes/order/alignment preserved for23,155 rows;23,154 complete;4 OHLC-envelope failures and1 all-null row remain unchanged.16 US labels return2021-10-04–2026-10-02; GEV2024-03-27–2026-10-02; JP/KR coverage explicit. Security identity/session/historical availability/adjustment/quote-state admission remains unverified. JPX schedule changes and KRX vendor-session conflicts documented. General historical raw-store bytes are absent in this checkout;58 Yahoo-named records represent Tiingo close-only transformations.

Portfolio: ACTUAL remains NOT_AVAILABLE; reusable Decimal multi-account weights exist but concrete real holdings/history do not. FX conversion/cash/account completeness source-binding gaps documented. Public SEC/JPX/KRX classification candidates recorded; no taxonomy, type rubric, assignment, crosswalk or numeric policy adopted.

ChartDocument:14 adequacy dimensions reviewed;7 v0.2 corrections PROPOSED/NOT_APPROVED/NOT_ACTIVE. Immutable payload vs mutable authority, owner Decimal context, unavailable vs diagnostics, per-input dependency closure, time clocks, classification versions/completeness and exact-subject lifecycle. No v0.1 rewrite or implementation.

Independent evidence verification:19 originals and all row counts reproduced;46 baseline source pins plus41 Market/Portfolio source checks match;7750 existing tracked files unchanged. Production tests/Actions/exact-result FPIA NOT_RUN for this work. Existing75 demo tests are historical, not upgraded. Fresh Integration observation: Draft PR42 dc0bf79 exists; its Actions were IN_PROGRESS, not completed FPIA acceptance.

See p0-prerequisites/P0_IMPLEMENTATION_PREREQUISITES_v0.2.md, market/, portfolio/, contract/ and root/verification.json for actual dependencies and non-protected versus after-FPIA work. Current composition and optional quarterly history have separate data dependencies.
